theme: Susa mass, mark and context source audit
question: Do original catalogues and museum images support the modern marked-weight packets?
outcome: Recovered three signed mass discrepancies, including AS 13820 changing from 2769 g to 3067 g. Two original ducks described as unmarked conflict with modern stroke counts. Recovered the four-cup image, an AS 13855 four-stroke 335 g comparison, twelfth-century BCE deposition of SB 17774 and a cross-weight locator mismatch.
challenge: Inventory, mass, material and mark descriptions disagree. One imported weight has distant creation and deposition periods. The Ascalone 2023 route returned login HTML.
remedy: Preserve source-specific descriptions and measurements, reject HTML as a PDF, retain provisional accession joins, separate creation and deposition, and preserve the earlier fit. No new fit was run.
retry_when: Independent SB/AS concordance, conservation/weighing history, all-face marked photographs, dated assemblages or AS13855 modern registration resolves a source disagreement.
